public_payload.normalized_proposition: OpenAI has signed deals it cannot afford or raise money for, will burn $300 billion, and has no path to profitability.

statement.excerpt: I need to be blunter: OpenAI has signed multiple different deals and contracts for amounts it cannot afford to pay, that it cannot hope to raise the money to pay for, that defy the amounts of venture capital and private credit available, all to sustain a company that will burn $300 billion and has no path to profitability of any kind.

from_speaker: signed multiple different deals and contracts
cannot hope to raise the money to pay for
has no path to profitability of any kind
our_interpretation: This is a compound forecast about funding existing commitments, cumulative cash burn, and eventual profitability.
The ordinary reading is that OpenAI cannot obtain sufficient resources to honor the commitments as payments fall due. It does not require holding the entire contract value in cash immediately.
Burn means cumulative net cash consumption, consistent with the surrounding discussion of negative free cash flow. Financing receipts are excluded from that measure.
The $300 billion figure is the author's estimate based on reported projections. No accounting standard is supplied.
The sentence gives no firm deadline or unambiguous starting date for cumulative burn. Nearby projections do not impose one on every component.
Profitability means company-wide profit after business expenses, rather than a profitable product or an adjusted measure excluding major costs.
criteria.support_condition: Records establish inability to finance or pay the identified commitments, cumulative net cash burn of approximately $300 billion, and ultimate failure to reach company-wide profitability. All components must be established to support the compound claim.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Records establish sufficient funding and payment of the identified commitments, or sustained company-wide profitability. A completed liquidation with a reliably established lifetime burn materially below $300 billion would contradict the burn component. Partial findings must be reported separately.

public_payload.what_would_resolve: Contract-level funding and payment records, a consistent series of realized cash flows, and company-wide earnings or final liquidation accounts. A decisive component outcome should be identified without treating it as proof of every component.
